description.zh: 70 个位置扩展全身覆盖。两种带通 BP 三维体等权相加，深度显示保留 0.3 Frangi。
description.en: Seventy positions extend whole-body coverage. Two bandpass BP volumes are added with equal weights; depth display retains a 0.3 Frangi contribution.

display.depth_scale: Relative position within the displayed Z slab, 0–1

view_notes.zh: 灰度为强度；颜色为相对深度。各样本独立线性窗。
view_notes.en: Grayscale encodes intensity; colour encodes relative depth. Each specimen has an independent linear window.

acquisition.zh: 7×10 位置；6×8 mm 步距；每位置 20 次曝光
acquisition.en: 7×10 positions; 6×8 mm steps; 20 exposures per position

reconstruction.en: 1508.5 m/s BP; 1.44–5.76 + 0.5–8 MHz; unit-weight voxelwise sum
